title: Blue Lions intro and classroom bridge

payloads.title: Black Eagles Comparison
payloads.prompt:
Slow controlled push-in across the academy courtyard. Edelgard remains composed in the foreground while Hubert stands slightly behind like a quiet shadow. Background students cross softly out of focus. Keep the mood political and restrained, with no overt threat. Minimal facial movement: Edelgard watches, Hubert observes.

Camera: slow push-in, long lens, stable.
payloads.negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: villain posing, sudden gestures, war costumes, text.

payloads.prompt:

Camera: slight lateral drift, relaxed handheld stability.

Camera: smooth side glide, medium-wide.

payloads.title: Dimitri Greeting
payloads.prompt:
Dimitri steps forward and bows with formal sincerity while Dedue remains quietly behind him. Byleth stands calm in the foreground. Dimitri's expression is polite, responsible, and young, with only a faint weight behind the courtesy.

Camera: gentle push from Byleth's side toward Dimitri.

payloads.title: Felix / Sylvain Exchange
payloads.prompt:
Felix holds a cold, cutting gaze toward Byleth while Sylvain softens the tension with relaxed body language. Felix should move very little: a slight head turn or narrowed eyes is enough. Sylvain gives a small sideways glance, trying to keep the exchange socially smooth.

Camera: steady medium two-shot with Byleth shoulder foreground.

payloads.title: Blue Lions Reaction Montage
payloads.prompt:
Create a soft reaction montage from the still: Mercedes offers a gentle reassuring look, Annette reacts with nervous energy, Ashe watches earnestly, and Ingrid remains serious and attentive. Keep Mercedes youthful and warm; keep Ashe boyish with pale ash-gray hair.

Camera: subtle rack focus between faces, no fast cuts inside the generated clip.
payloads.negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: aging Mercedes, brown- or blond-haired Ashe, overdramatic expressions.

payloads.title: First Class Wide
payloads.prompt:
Byleth stands before the seated Blue Lions in the academy classroom. Students shift slightly in their seats and look toward the new teacher. The room should feel formal but tense with curiosity. Byleth is calm, direct, and unreadable.

Camera: slow classroom push-in from behind Byleth.

payloads.title: Training Sword Insert
payloads.prompt:
Byleth places or slides a training sword onto the wooden desk with deliberate calm. Students' hands or sleeves remain still around the edges of the frame. The motion should be quiet and decisive, signaling that the lesson will move to practice.

Camera: low close insert, slight push toward the sword.

payloads.title: Felix Stands
payloads.prompt:
Felix rises from his desk with restrained impatience, interested for the first time. Other Blue Lions students watch from behind. His movement should be controlled and youthful, with a cold narrow gaze rather than open aggression.

Camera: small upward tilt following Felix standing.
